    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "#LAB ASSIGNMENT / 02\n",
        "Image Synthesis Using GANs"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "L64s9OyZhgoh"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##Step 1: Load and Scale Images"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "-oOjQIzAhgG_"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": 1,
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "A2Dp6-bmhdPa",
        "outputId": "71451c1e-8497-49f0-a54a-bb04977a029d"
      },
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stderr",
          "text": [
            "100%|██████████| 26.4M/26.4M [00:02<00:00, 12.8MB/s]\n",
            "100%|██████████| 29.5k/29.5k [00:00<00:00, 202kB/s]\n",
            "100%|██████████| 4.42M/4.42M [00:01<00:00, 3.75MB/s]\n",
            "100%|██████████| 5.15k/5.15k [00:00<00:00, 9.08MB/s]\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "from torch import nn\n",
        "from torch.utils.data import DataLoader\n",
        "from torchvision import datasets, transforms\n",
        "from torchvision.utils import make_grid\n",
        "transform = transforms.Compose([\n",
        "transforms.ToTensor(), transforms.Normalize((0.5,), (0.5,))\n",
        "])\n",
        "data = datasets.FashionMNIST(\"data\", train=True, download=True,\n",
        "transform=transform)\n",
        "loader = DataLoader(data, batch_size=128, shuffle=True)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##Step 2: Define Both Networks"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "j5aIAV7Rk1og"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import torch\n",
        "device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')\n",
        "\n",
        "latent_dim = 64\n",
        "G = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(latent_dim, 256), nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),\n",
        "nn.Linear(256, 512), nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),\n",
        "nn.Linear(512, 784), nn.Tanh()).to(device)\n",
        "D = nn.Sequential(nn.Flatten(), nn.Linear(784, 512), nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),\n",
        "nn.Linear(512, 256), nn.LeakyReLU(0.2),\n",
        "nn.Linear(256, 1)).to(device)\n",
        "loss_fn = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()\n",
        "opt_g = torch.optim.Adam(G.parameters(), lr=0.0002, betas=(0.5, 0.999))\n",
        "opt_d = torch.optim.Adam(D.parameters(), lr=0.0002, betas=(0.5, 0.999))\n",
        "fixed_z = torch.randn(25, latent_dim, device=device)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "g_-OG5wwk18S"
      },
      "execution_count": 3,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##Step 3: Implement Alternating Updates"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "dTv8pp2glBkC"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from pathlib import Path\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ensure output directory exists\n",
        "out = Path(\"output\")\n",
        "out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "def generate_grid(epoch):\n",
        "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "        images = G(fixed_z).cpu().reshape(-1, 1, 28, 28)\n",
        "        grid = make_grid((images + 1) / 2, nrow=5)\n",
        "        plt.figure(figsize=(5, 5))\n",
        "        plt.imshow(grid.permute(1, 2, 0))\n",
        "        plt.title(f\"Epoch {epoch}\")\n",
        "        plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "        plt.savefig(out / f\"gan_epoch_{epoch:02d}.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
        "        plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "def train_batch(real):\n",
        "    n = real.size(0)\n",
        "    real = real.to(device)\n",
        "    fake = G(torch.randn(n, latent_dim, device=device))\n",
        "    real_logits = D(real)\n",
        "    fake_logits = D(fake.detach())\n",
        "    d_loss = (loss_fn(real_logits, torch.ones_like(real_logits))\n",
        "              + loss_fn(fake_logits, torch.zeros_like(fake_logits))) / 2\n",
        "    opt_d.zero_grad()\n",
        "    d_loss.backward()\n",
        "    opt_d.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "    D.requires_grad_(False)\n",
        "    opt_g.zero_grad()\n",
        "    logits = D(fake)\n",
        "    g_loss = loss_fn(logits, torch.ones_like(logits))\n",
        "    g_loss.backward()\n",
        "    opt_g.step()\n",
        "    D.requires_grad_(True)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return d_loss.item(), g_loss.item()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "Z8AwtRNblGAX"
      },
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "##Step 4: Train and Compare Epochs"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "I5B9ZlGulOEP"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "history = []\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, 11):\n",
        "    losses = [train_batch(real.to(device)) for real, _ in loader]\n",
        "    avg_d, avg_g = [sum(values) / len(losses) for values in zip(*losses)]\n",
        "    history.append((avg_d, avg_g))\n",
        "    print(f\"{epoch:02d} D={avg_d:.3f} G={avg_g:.3f}\")\n",
        "    if epoch in (1, 5, 10):\n",
        "        generate_grid(epoch)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(range(1, 11), [d for d, g in history], label=\"Discriminator\")\n",
        "plt.plot(range(1, 11), [g for d, g in history], label=\"Generator\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Epoch\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Mean batch loss\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.savefig(out / \"gan_losses.png\", bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "torch.save(G.state_dict(), out / \"fashion_generator.pt\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {

          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
